thread:
jess: Heads-up — NovaCredit reporting p99 tail spikes (~2-3x baseline) around 02:00-03:00 UTC since last night. ~8% 502s, queue depth rising on pool-dedicated-4. Can we get an overnight routing workaround (route Nova -> model-fallback-small) while eng-platform investigates? Need owner + ETA.

owen: On it. Can someone drop traces/log links? I’ll triage ASAP.

jess: Logs/traces: https://logs.redwood.internal/nova/streams/abc123 — quick tail of queue depth below.

```
2026-03-16T01:58:22Z pool-dedicated-4 queue_depth=18 host=req-12
2026-03-16T01:59:05Z pool-dedicated-4 queue_depth=27 host=req-09
2026-03-16T02:01:10Z 502 error count spike (8% of 1m window)
```

raj: I can push a temporary route change. Plan: create a rule sending Nova traffic to model-fallback-small (weight=100) with a 20 TPS cap and circuit breaker. Monitor for 1h, escalate if fallback saturates. Need SRE/devops ok for capacity reservation.

devops: 20 TPS is acceptable short-term but we must reserve capacity on pool-fallback-1. If fallback saturates -> more 503s. Recommend rate-limit + a circuit-breaker threshold at ~70% GPU util.

maria: I’ll own monitoring. I’ll add a quick dashboard + alerts for fallback p50/p99, queue depth, and 5m error rate. Please ping me when change is live.

oncall-bot: Incident created: INC-2026-432 — https://incidents.redwood.internal/INC-2026-432 (severity: P1)

raj: Putting the exact config I’ll apply (will run with deploy-bot approval):

```
curl -X POST https://api.redwood.internal/v1/routing \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer $TOKEN" \
  -H "Content-Type: application/json" \
  -d '{\n    "customer":"nova",\n    "routes":[{"model":"model-fallback-small","weight":100}],\n    "rate_limit":20,\n    "circuit_breaker": {"gpu_util_pct":70},\n    "note":"temporary overnight workaround 02-04UTC"\n  }'
```

jess: Thanks. Raj, please comment the PR and tag me. ETA?

raj: Deploying in ~5m, will post when active. (need deploy-bot signoff)

deploy-bot: Approving deploy for route change r-9f8a. Starting rollout.

owen: I’ll follow traces and check if backend latency or a specific model revision is causing queues. If we still see 502s from model after routing change, we’ll rollback.

raj: Change is live, route_id=r-9f8a. Switching 100% traffic for nova to model-fallback-small with 20 TPS cap. Monitoring hooks enabled.

maria: Dashboards up, alert created to #eng-oncall and pager duty. Early signal: 502 rate down to 0.7% at 02:15 UTC. Queue depth on pool-dedicated-4 dropping.

jess: Great. Next steps: eng-platform to own RCA — queue backlog analysis, model runtime metrics, autoscale config for pool-dedicated-4. Owner: owen. Please start a doc and post link.

owen: Taking owner for RCA. I’ll collect logs, check model mem/latency, and autoscale events. Targeting initial PMR notes by EOD tomorrow. Doc: https://go.redwood/docs/rca/nova-p1 (adding notes now).

maria: I’ll watch the channel through the night until 06:00 UTC and handoff to the morning oncall. If fallback shows signs of saturation I’ll page.

jess: Thanks all — appreciate the quick turnaround :thumbsup: 

(REMINDER) action items:
- raj: temporary route + config applied (done)
- maria: monitoring + alerts (done)
- owen: RCA owner (in progress)
- devops: reserve capacity on pool-fallback-1 and validate autoscale thresholds (pending)
- jess: coordinate post-mortem and customer update tomorrow AM (pending)

jess: Marking this thread for visibility; will circle back with customer update after RCA.
